distribution: Menglian, Yunnan; abroad it occurs in Myanmar, Bangladesh, Thailand and Vietnam.
soldier: Head capsule chestnut brown, varying in shade, darker on the frons; thorax and abdomen greyish yellow tinged with brown. Long hairs scattered over the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin almost straight. Frontal peaks slightly raised, the frontal surface with shallow rugae; in lateral view the frontal peaks slightly higher than the posterior margin of the head. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest and slightly shorter than segment 2. Labrum bell-shaped, the tip slightly projecting. Mandibular body almost rod-like, rather stout, the apex slender and distinctly curved; the inner margin with fine serrations, the re-entrant angle of the outer margin at the mandibular base rather deep; the middle of the postmentum projecting, the waist region behind the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin distinctly incised, the posterior margin straight.
taxonomy_note: The genus name was printed in the original work as Mierocerotermes, a spelling error for Microcerotermes; the genus name now used is identical with the latter.
